content.systemBoundary: A wrist-worn tremor monitoring system that captures hand-tremor motion data, attaches timestamps and calibration metadata, stores an analysis-ready log, and supports later export and summary review while keeping measurement targets as open questions until confirmed.

nodes.name: Wearable Session Configuration Input
responsibilities: Accept user-intended tremor monitoring session context.
Provide placeholders for unknown wearable runtime, tremor frequency range, sampling rate, and calibration/form-factor constraints.
Surface privacy-sensitive handling considerations as non-medical constraints for later clarification.

nodes.name: Hand Tremor Motion Acquisition
responsibilities: Measure hand tremors while the device is worn.
Capture motion data samples suitable for later analysis.
Emit motion samples for timestamp association and later storage.

nodes.name: Timestamp + Calibration Metadata Association
responsibilities: Attach calibration/form-factor metadata placeholders needed for consistent later interpretation.
Propagate unknown measurement targets to analysis metadata without treating them as confirmed.

nodes.name: Timestamped Motion Storage
responsibilities: Buffer and persist a motion log containing timestamped measurements and associated calibration metadata.
Support exportable records whose volume depends on sampling-rate needs.

nodes.name: Tremor-Focused Motion Analysis
responsibilities: Aggregate stored records into analysis summaries oriented to tremor motion interpretation.
Highlight mismatches between assumed and confirmed tremor frequency range, runtime coverage, and sampling-rate targets.
Produce decision-ready outputs for next embedded prototype steps while remaining functional and non-component-specific.

nodes.name: Motion Data Export
responsibilities: Export analysis-ready motion datasets for later review.
Include references to open questions that constrain how later interpretation should proceed (e.g., runtime, frequency range, sampling, calibration/form-factor).
Make privacy-sensitive handling assumptions explicit for later clarification.

edges.description: Session constraints and unknown placeholders are applied to acquisition behavior without committing to components.
Raw motion samples are emitted for timestamp and calibration-metadata association.
Associated motion records are persisted as timestamped logs with calibration metadata.
Stored records are aggregated to produce tremor-oriented analysis summaries and highlight unknown constraints.
Analysis outputs are exported for later dataset review and next-step planning.

assumptions.statement: Functional architecture can treat wearable runtime, frequency-range needs, sampling-rate targets, and calibration/form-factor assumptions as configurable placeholders without committing to specific components.
